belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that conditions environmental has inconsistent effects on alteration brain connections neural. The evidence base (3 findings, 3 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

latent_variables.name: Mechanism selection
latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Psychophysics / Perception, Distraction Theory). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of conditions environmental, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of conditions environmental on alteration brain connections neural replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains conditions environmental → alteration brain connections neural?
research_needs.rationale: 2 candidate mechanisms exist. Process tracing would identify the active pathway.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for conditions environmental effects on alteration brain connections neural?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
